<!-- pr-reviewer: 30c4c7ef0e1425ba154e46b2b8fba33c14fe1ebb -->
Ready to merge. Independent safety read (read-only) at head `148d3bf1c`, a check of the delta to this head, and a trial merge by an agent that did not write the change.

- The read found one blocker at `148d3bf1c`: the inch feed of the Haas post went from two to four decimals, and the inch goldens of `program_units` did not move. This head regenerates the two goldens. The delta `148d3bf1c..30c4c7ef0` changes four files: the two goldens (only F words differ), comments in `program_units.rs`, and the decision file.
- The read found no other blocker. `ff()` cannot print an exponent or a value that is not finite. `tapPitchHolds()` judges the F and S words as written. A stopped spindle is refused before the pitch check.
- Trial: main `81643a2a4` + this head, merge commit `a799096f7` on a scratch branch, no conflict. `camcraft-post` whole crate: 1072 pass, 0 fail. 16 app test binaries, 0 fail (`program_units` 7, `conformance` 7, `rigid_tapping` 5, `tap_hand` 7, `example_catalog` 39). clippy `-D warnings` for `camcraft-post`: clean. `git status` after the tests: empty.
- Main is now `3994f1942` (two example files only). `git merge-tree` is clean and no file is common.
- Heavy lanes: not run. No Haas control ran the program.
- The standalone `post` binary writes the file with the warning when a tap is refused; the application blocks the post. This is the same for every refusal of a post script.

The PR is flagged ready for the merge. Nothing is pushed after this flag.
